RESOLUTIONS OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS
OF KESTREL ANALYTICS CORPORATION

Adopted at a special meeting held on September 9, 2026

BANKING AND TREASURY AUTHORITY

WHEREAS, the Board of Directors (the "Board") of Kestrel Analytics Corporation, a Delaware corporation (the "Corporation"), has determined that it is in the best interests of the Corporation to establish a deposit and treasury relationship with Harborview Commercial Bank, N.A. (the "Bank");

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT

RESOLVED, that the Corporation is authorized to open, maintain, and close deposit accounts, and to obtain treasury-management services, at the Bank;

RESOLVED FURTHER, that each of the Chief Executive Officer, the Chief Financial Officer, and the Treasurer of the Corporation (each, an "Authorized Officer") is authorized, acting alone, to execute and deliver the Bank's account agreements, signature cards, treasury-management service agreements, and any related documents, in each case in the form the Authorized Officer approves, that approval to be conclusively evidenced by execution;

RESOLVED FURTHER, that any single Authorized Officer may initiate, approve, and release payments from the Corporation's accounts at the Bank up to $250,000 per transaction, and that any payment above that amount requires the approval of two Authorized Officers;

RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Bank is authorized to honor and act upon instructions given by any Authorized Officer in accordance with the foregoing, and is entitled to rely on these resolutions until it receives written notice of their revocation or amendment;

RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Secretary of the Corporation is directed to certify these resolutions to the Bank and to provide the Bank with the incumbency and specimen signatures of each Authorized Officer, and to notify the Bank promptly of any change; and

RESOLVED FURTHER, that all actions taken by any officer of the Corporation before the adoption of these resolutions in furtherance of the foregoing are ratified, confirmed, and approved in all respects.

CERTIFICATION

I, Priya Venkataraman, Secretary of Kestrel Analytics Corporation, certify that the foregoing resolutions were duly adopted by the Board of Directors at a special meeting duly called and held on September 9, 2026, at which a quorum was present and acting throughout, and that these resolutions have not been amended, modified, or rescinded and remain in full force and effect as of the date below.

Dated: September 10, 2026

_______________________________
Priya Venkataraman, Secretary
